recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It narrowly completes the seed clarification on current terminology and binding surfaces while preserving the existing narrative, constraints, noMap behavior, relationship behavior, and already-audited later ConceptMap decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-14686 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue for STU3. It said ConceptMap.group.unmapped was unclear, especially the phrase "no match in the mappings in the group," and asked whether the element supplied fallback mapping behavior, unmatched guidance, or something else.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in SVN revision 13358, now git commit fed48b46b1cb32a986d70fd4c69d9b569a0aab61, which updated ConceptMap introduction text and the then-authoritative spreadsheet definitions. Companion FHIR-14687 was later applied by d75acd989aa64eb9de7ae6a439abe0b3377ecfdd, adding the Handling Unmapped Codes narrative.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. Later ConceptMap changes renamed provided to use-source-code, renamed url to otherMap, added noMap/comment behavior, and clarified unmapped modes. FHIR-14687 and FHIR-22100 are already represented on the combined branch, so this reconciliation was limited to the seed-specific stale descriptions.
reconciliation: Changed the ConceptMap.group.unmapped.mode binding description and the conceptmap-unmapped-mode CodeSystem and ValueSet descriptions from "no match in the group" to wording that says the fallback action applies when a source concept has no explicit mapping target in the group.

source/conceptmap/valueset-conceptmap-unmapped-mode.xml: clarified the ValueSet description for unmapped mode.
